detail: Every one of the thirty-four published negatives, read on 22 September 2026, asking ONE question of each: DOES IT SHOW THAT THE INSTRUMENT WAS ANSWERING? A zero means nothing without it, as this archive proved three times in one evening on a single probate search.

THREE ARE WITHDRAWN and are not live negatives. NINE ARE NOT NAME SEARCHES at all — a coverage count, a structural argument about consular registers, two questions about what a register FORM asked for, a holdings question, a question about what is online, a DNA argument, and an archive's signed answer about whether two series survive. A control on a search box is not the relevant test for those. OF THE REMAINDER, MOST ALREADY CARRY ONE, and two carry particularly good ones.

finding: the two that were already well controlled
detail: NO. 5, Leonard's estate: "2,246 estate records in 1976, one in 1977, zero after" — the index is shown to be populated in the target years and to stop where it stops. NO. 22, the NAAIRS variant spellings: "THE FIRST TWO ATTEMPTS AT THIS SEARCH RETURNED ZERO AND WERE NOT BELIEVED" — a control story rather than a control number, and a better one.

finding: *** TWO WERE UNCONTROLLED AND HAVE NOW BEEN CONTROLLED ***
detail: NO. 8, Ivone's naturalisation, and NO. 16, the three sisters' estates. Both are gazettes.africa searches, and gazettes.africa is still reachable — so the controls were RUN rather than asserted.

The word NATURALIZATION appears in 28,470 SOUTH AFRICAN GAZETTE DOCUMENTS. The class is abundantly present, and the archive's earlier work read 246 gazettes carrying the heading in both series for 1975-76. Her absence is an absence from a populated record class.

finding: *** control for no. 16, AND IT NEARLY WENT THE OTHER WAY ***
detail: The phrase "Estates of deceased persons" returns 1,219 documents across the whole South African run — AND NOTHING FOR 2009 TO 2013. For a few minutes that looked like a coverage hole big enough to void the negative. IT IS NOT A HOLE, IT IS A CHANGE OF WORDING: "MASTER OF THE HIGH COURT" returns 6,594 documents, with 59 in 2009, 74 in 2010, 67 in 2011, 133 in 2012, 172 in 2013 and 164 in 2014. The years are in the corpus and the estate business is in them. THE FIRST CONTROL WOULD HAVE OVERTURNED A TRUE NEGATIVE, and the lesson is that a single control phrase is itself a single spelling.

finding: *** AND TWO REMAIN UNCONTROLLED, WHICH IS SAID RATHER THAN FIXED ***
detail: NO. 6, Leonard in the Johannesburg cemetery registers, and NO. 18, no Leibholz in the South African archives. Both state what they do NOT cover, which is a limit and not a control; neither shows that the search box was answering. THEIR INSTRUMENTS ARE OUT OF REACH — FamilySearch needs a sign-in and NAAIRS has stopped answering — SO NO CONTROL WAS INVENTED FOR THEM. A control that was not run is not a control, and writing one from memory would be exactly the fabrication this audit exists to prevent.

finding: what this audit deliberately did NOT do
detail: It did not retro-fit control language to searches nobody re-ran. Sixteen negatives were flagged by a crude keyword scan as lacking a control; READING THEM SHOWED MOST OF THAT TO BE THE SCAN'S VOCABULARY AND NOT THE ARCHIVE'S FAULT — a coverage bound, a structural argument about what an index contains, or a control told as a story. The scan's output is not the finding; the reading is.
The archive's own /negatives/ page, all 34 rows read individually 22 September 2026. New controls run live at gazettes.africa the same day.
